# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 側出泉也。从水殸聲。殸，籒文磬字。
魚# fish + 水 water → pull fish from water → *fishing*.
As per 票# (rise) + 水 water → object that rises to the surface of a body of water and floats → *float*; *drift*; *waft*; *wander*.
浮也。从水票聲。
桼# originally depicted cuts in a tree made at intervals, producing a slender trickle of sap. 漆 adds 水 water (→ liquid) → *lacquer* tree.
水。出右扶風杜陵岐山，東入渭。一曰入洛。从水桼聲。

As per 鹿# (long and winding) + 水 water → a long trail of dripping liquid → *filter*; *strain* (compare 濾). Also, *make (Japanese) paper* (a process that involves filtering considerable amounts of water).
浚也。从水鹿聲。
雨漊漊也。从水婁聲。一曰汝南謂飲酒習之不醉爲漊。

屚# is 尸 (here a shape indicator suggesting a roof) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → raindrops leaking through a roof. 漏 adds 水 water for emphasis/clarification → *leak* → *spill*; *escape*; *shine through* → *divulge*; *confide*; *reveal* → *give vent to*; *reject*; *omit*.
以銅受水，刻節，晝夜百刻。从水屚聲。
As per 既# (engorgement) + 水 water → engorge with water in irrigating → *irrigate* or *pour* at length.
水。出東海桑瀆覆甑山，東北入海。一曰灌注也。从水旣聲。
离 here an abbreviated form# of 離 (tangle; adhere) + 水 water → liquid that drips/sinks into and adheres to an object → *drip*; *sink into*. Compare 淋.
As per 寅# (straighten/stretch) + 水 water → stretch fluidly → *perform*; (theatrical) *play*.
長流也。一曰水名。从水寅聲。
As per 曹# (array) + 水 water → ship an array of goods by water → *ship cargo*. Also, *row* (← row a cargo boat) .
水轉轂也。一曰人之所乘及船也。从水曹聲。
水厓也。从水脣聲。《詩》曰：“寘河之漘。”
露皃。从水專聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 水 water → *soak* objects in a curved container → *foam*; *froth* (← foam/froth produced by lengthy soaking).
久漬也。从水區聲。
As per 莫# (concealed) + 水 water → *desert* (where water sources are concealed) → *vast*; *vague*.
北方流沙也。一曰清也。从水莫聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of 𦰩 shows the stretched hide of an animal tied to a frame + 火 fire → stretch an object for drying over a fire. According to this process the object shrinks, leaving a minute remainder. 漢 is as per 𦰩# (stretch) + 水 water → great, stretching river → the Milky Way (← constellation likened to a great, flowing river). The meaning *China* comes from a broad application of 漢's use in the name of the Hanshui River ( 漢水) in Hubei Province. Also, *man* (← ordinary male ← general populace ← general term for China).
漾也。東爲滄浪水。从水，難省聲。
連# be in a row + 水 water → rows of *ripples*. Compare 瀾, as well as 淪.
清水也。一曰窊也。从水窐聲。
順流也。一曰水名。从水𠩺聲。
As per 曼# (cover/be covered) + 水 water → unrestrained water covering a vast area → *aimless*; *wide-ranging* → *involuntarily*.
As per 責# (pile) + 水 water → *soak* a pile of objects (e.g., vegetables in brine, clothes in dye etc.) → *preserve*; *pickle* (compare 酢).
漚也。从水責聲。
As per 莽# (concealed) + 水 water → inundation (compare 汒 as described in 茫) concealing all that lies beneath → *water spreading endlessly*; *vast*; *expansive*.
水虛也。从水康聲。
欶# suck + 水 water → *rinse* one's mouth by sucking in water → *wash*; *gargle*.
盪口也。从水欶聲。
張# stretch + 水 water → stretch of river that rises/swells → *overflow*. Compare 滕.
濁漳，出上黨長子鹿谷山，東入清漳。清漳，出沾山大要谷，北入河。南漳，出南郡臨沮。从水章聲。
水浦也。从水敘聲。
水。在魯。从水郭聲。
As per 斬# (cut) + 水 water → partially cut the flow of water (compare 澀/渋 and 減) penetrating a crevice (compare 浸) → *gradual* (← partial/gradual cut) → *gradually*.
水。出丹陽黟南蠻中，東入海。从水斬聲。
水。出西河中陽北沙，南入河。从水焉聲。
清深也。从水翏聲。
深也。从水崔聲。《詩》曰：“有漼者淵。”
As per the right-hand element# of 樣 (waterway) + 水 water (for emphasis/clarification) → *flow*; *ripple*; *swirl*; *drift*. Also, *be tossed about*.
水。出隴西相道，東至武都爲漢。从水羕聲。
As per 將# (long and slender) + 水 water → liquid poured in a long, slender trail (compare 醬) → (thick) *liquid substance* → *general term for drinks*.
水。出潁川陽城乾山，東入淮。从水頃聲。豫州浸。
於水中擊絮也。从水敝聲。
As per 矞# (circular) + 水 water → *water gushing from a round spring* (compare 泉).
涌出也。一曰水中坻，人所爲，爲潏。一曰潏，水名，在京兆杜陵。从水矞聲。
盡也。从水焦聲。
As per 發# (split away in being released) + 水 water → release water in sprinkling/pouring → *sprinkle*; *pour*; *splash* → *leap* (← splash upwards).
水潒瀁也。从水象聲。讀若蕩。
水。出廬江，入淮。从水惠聲。
As per 絜# (separate) + 水 water → cleansing torrent of water that separates out impurities → *pure* → *righteous*; *manly*.
瀞也。从水絜聲。
水。出南陽舞陽，東入潁。从水無聲。
As per 番# (spread) + 水 water → grain spread throughout water in which it is washed → *water in which rice has been washed* → *whirlpool*.
淅米汁也。一曰水名，在河南滎陽。从水番聲。
深清也。从水肅聲。

朁# is 兓 deep penetration + 曰 say/speech indicator → utterance that penetrates deeply. 潛 adds 水 water → penetrate deep into water in diving/submerging → *dive/submerge* → *lurk*; *hide* (← lie in wait in deep concealment) → *conceal*; *secret*; *latent*. Also, *hush*, *lower one's voice*, and *get/crawl into* (becoming hidden). Note that there is no etymological relation between the Shinjitai 潜 and the character 替.
涉水也。一曰藏也。一曰漢水爲潛。从水朁聲。
水疾聲。从水翕聲。
冀州浸也。上黨有潞縣。从水路聲。
Variant# of 舃 (double/pile up) + 水 water → *tidelands*; *tidal flats* (where water laps upon itself) → *lagoon*.
含水噴也。从水巽聲。
As per 黃# (extend) + 水 water → *wide expanse of water* (compare 汪, 泂 and 浤) → *pond*.
積水池。从水黃聲。
水流浼浼皃。从水閔聲。
As per 閏# (concealed) + 水 water → liquid concealed in the earth that slowly oozes out → *ooze*; *moisten* → *benefit*; *enrich*; *profit*. Also, *dim/cloudy* (← concealing mist).
水曰潤下。从水閏聲。
As per 尞# as described in 僚 (circular continuum) + 水 water → *puddle* (← result of *prolonged rain*) → a *muddle*. For puddle, compare 溜.
雨水大皃。从水尞聲。
水。出鄭國。从水曾聲。《詩》曰：“潧與洧，方渙渙兮。”
As per 衆# (run together) + 水 water → *confluence* → *the sound of converging flows of water*.
小水入大水曰潨。从水从眾。《詩》曰：“鳧鷖在潨。”
水。出河南密縣大隗山，南入潁。从水異聲。
覃# extensive + 水 water → extensive *water-filled abyss* → *deep pool*; *deep*.
水。出武陵鐔成玉山，東入鬱林。从水覃聲。
朝# morning + 水 water → *morning tide*; *tidal current* → *salt/sea water*.
As per 尋# (settled) + 水 water → deep, settled water of a pool by a shore/bank → *deep water*; *deep pool of water*.
㫄深也。从水尋聲。

As per 貴# (compress) + 水 water → structure compressed in collapsing due to overflowing water (compare 濊) → *collapse*; *rout/be routed*; *crush* → *sore* (← inflammation bursting through the wall of an internal organ ← water bursting through a structure).
漏也。从水貴聲。
An abbreviated form# of (the seal inscription style of) 散 scatter + 水 water → liquid scattering from the eyes in the form of *flowing tears*.
涕流皃。从水，𢿱省聲。《詩》曰：“潸焉出涕。”
孱# weak + 水 water → barely audible murmuring *sound of flowing water*.
水聲。从水孱聲。
水。出廣漢梓潼北界，南入墊江。从水童聲。
不流濁也。从水圍聲。

The relevant seal inscription form of 歰 shows that the doubled element on top was originally inverted feet, so that the character featured two feet pointing downward + two feet pointing upward → tangling of legs → be stopped. 澀 adds 水 water → liquid that does not flow, but seeps (compare 漸) → *proceed haltingly* → *astringency* (← tongue rendered numb by the deep penetration of astringent juices; compare 浸) → *sober*. Also, *be unwilling/reluctant*, *austere*, *quiet* and *stingy*. 歮 is a variant form of 歰, and 澁 a variant form of 澀. In contemporary Japanese orthography, 澀/澁 is written 渋.
清也。从水，徵省聲。
登# rise + 水 water → the clear part of a liquid substance that rises to the top → *make/become clear* → *clean*; *transparent*; *purify* → *serene*. Also, *put on airs* (← superior to others ← pure).
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 水 water → *sprinkle/pour water* (from high above, in an arc) → *slight*; *thin* (← slight trickle of water).
𣵽也。从水堯聲。
水。出扶風鄠，北入渭。从水勞聲。
斯# split + 水 water → water splitting its container and draining out until it runs out → *drain dry*; *run out*; *use up*.
水索也。从水斯聲。
時雨，澍生萬物。从水尌聲。
As per 彭# (rhythmic pattern) + 水 water → (the sound of) *surging/rushing water*.
江水大波謂之澐。从水雲聲。
水。出鬱林郡。从水畱聲。
丹沙所化，爲水銀也。从水項聲。
間# gap + 水 water → *valley river* (running through a mountain) → *valley*.
山夾水也。从水閒聲。一曰澗水，出弘農新安，東南入洛。
As per 喿# as described in 操 (activity taking place above) + 水 water → float above, on the surface of water → *bathe*; *wash*.
洒手也。从水喿聲。
As per 幹# (rise high) + 水 water → overflow of water that disperses random objects (compare 渙) → *wash* (← wash away in dispersing).
As per 睪# (align) + 水 water → *swamp*; *marsh* (alignment of water and grassland in a shallow body of water).
光潤也。从水睪聲。
郣澥，海之別也。从水解聲。一說：澥即澥谷也。
水。出南陽雉衡山，東入汝。从水豊聲。
埤增水邊土。人所止者。从水筮聲。《夏書》曰：“過三澨。”
夏有水，冬無水，曰澩。从水，學省聲。讀若學。
As per 零# (prolonged rain/drizzle) + 水 water → prolonged stretched of water → *water route*.
久雨涔資也。一曰水名。从水資聲。
水。出靃山，西南入汾。从水會聲。
As per 殿# (settle) + 水 water → *sediment* settled at the bottom of a *stagnant pool* of water → *stagnant*; *dregs*. Compare 淀.
滓滋也。从水殿聲。
奧# deep + 水 water → *inlet* winding *deep* into land; *bend in a river*; *deep water*. In Japan, the character also has the meaning *offshore*.
隈，厓也。其内曰澳，其外曰隈。从水奥聲。
澶淵水。在宋。从水亶聲。
詹 here an abbreviated form# of 憺 calm + 水 water → *calm*, *tranquil* waters → *plain*; *simple*.
水搖也。从水詹聲。
水。出汝南上蔡黑閭澗，入汝。从水意聲。
As per 辟# (spread) + 水 water → spread in (liquid) *bleach*.

敫# combines 白 white + 放 scatter → waves colliding with rocks, scattering white spray. 激 adds 水 water for emphasis/clarification → *turbulence*; *violence*; *intense*; *severe*; *extreme*; *fast* → *be excited*; *urge*; *encourage*.
水礙衺疾波也。从水敫聲。一曰半遮也。
As per 蜀# (adhere) + 水 water → mud, in which objects adhere → *become muddy/cloudy/turbid* → *murky*; *unclear*; *fuzzy*; *impure*; *act evasively* → *voiced consonant/sound*.
水。出齊郡厲嬀山，東北入鉅定。从水蜀聲。
As per 農# (soft and sticky) + 水 water → sticky liquid → *thick*; *dense*; *strong*; *dark* (color).
露多也。从水農聲。《詩》曰：“零露濃濃。”
水。受淮陽扶溝浪湯渠，東入淮。从水過聲。
As per 賁# (swell) + 水 water → *spouting/gushing water*. Also, *shoreline* (← waves crashing on a shoreline) and *confusion* (← mental turbulence).
水厓也。从水賁聲。《詩》曰：“敦彼淮濆。”
不滑也。从水嗇聲。
和也。从水戢聲。

歳 here an abbreviated form# of 穢 dirty; filthy + 水 water → destructive overflow of water, leaving dirt/filth in its wake → *vast/expansive*; *dirty*; *filthy*. For the idea of a destructive overflow of water, compare 潰.
水多皃。从水歲聲。
滿也。从水爾聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 水 water + an element# representing bundles of thread pressed together → soften bundles of thread by submerging them in water → *wet*; *moisten*; *damp* → *rain*. There is no etymological connection with the 㬎element described in 顯.
水。出東郡東武陽，入海。从水㬎聲。桑欽云：出平原高唐。
As per 寧# (settle) + 水 water → *mud* in which objects settle → *muddy*; *mire*. Compare 泥 and 淖.
滎濘也。从水寕聲。
As per 蒙# (cover/conceal) + 水 water → concealing *drizzle*; *misty rain* (compare 溟) → *dim*; *vague*.
微雨也。从水蒙聲。
水暴至聲。从水鼻聲。

As per 齊# (align) + 水 water → goods in alignment on opposite sides of a river → *ferry* (across); *cross* (a river); *pass safely* → *relieve*; *aid*; *help* (← ferry material aid) → *manage* (to do/with); *finish*; *be over/at an end* → *economic management*; *settle an account*; *pay* → *settle* (a matter). Also, *do without* (← manage to do without) and *adjust*.
水。出常山房子贊皇山，東入泜。从水齊聲。
As per 豪# (stretch at length) + 水 water → *moat* stretching about an edifice. *Australia* is via the phonetic construction 濠太剌利. Compare 壕.
As per 需# (soft) + 水 water → soften in liquid → *moisten*; *soak*; *immerse* → *be/get wet*; *be/get damp*. 濡 was devised to replace 需 after 需 acquired its borrowed meanings.
水。出涿郡故安，東入漆涑。从水需聲。
小溼也。从水翠聲。
壽# (long and curved) + 水 water → large, swelling waves → *swell*; (high) *wave*. Compare 波 and 浪. 涛 is a variant form sometimes encountered.
大波也。从水壽聲。
水脈行地中濥濥也。从水夤聲。
水。出潁川陽城少室山，東入潁。从水㥯聲。
A variant form# of 矍 (enclose in the hands) + 水 water → release a *trickle* of liquid from cupped hands → *drip*. Also, *boil* in cooking (← add a trickle of liquid ingredients and boil them ).
雨流霤下。从水蒦聲。
As per 監# (bowl/container) + 水 water → water overflowing a bowl or container → *overflow*; *inundate*; *excess*; (fall into) *disorder*. In modern Japanese usage, 乱 often replaces 濫 in compounds.
氾也。从水監聲。一曰濡上及下也。《詩》曰：“𧥑沸濫泉。”一曰清也。
水。出東郡濮陽，南入鉅野。从水僕聲。
As per 翟# (rise high) + 水 water → pluck an object from the water (compare 釣) in which it has been placed for washing, and raise it high to dry → *wash*; *rinse*; *launder*.
𤃬也。从水翟聲。
水。出琅邪箕屋山，東入海。徐州浸。《夏書》曰：“濰、淄其道。”从水維聲。
As per 賓# (contact) + 水 water → *shore/beach* (where land and water contact). 浜 originally represented another term, being as per 兵 (spread over) + 水 water → creek.
As per 賤# (slight amount) + 水 water → *sprinkle/splash on* or *spray* (a slight amount of water) → *pour*.
齊魯閒水也。从水樂聲。《春秋傳》曰：“公會齊侯于濼。”
As per 慮# (fineness) + 水 water → *filter/strain* (fine particles). Compare 漉.
